components.name: Java JSSE sessions on default settings (JDK version unknown)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 7 JSSE/HTTPS session sites on JDK default settings: HttpClient usages (Hub auth flow AuthFlowTask, key receive ReceiveKeyController, both register-device controllers, error reporting, UpdateCheckerHttpClient) plus the SSLContextDifferentTrustStoreBase base class feeding all truststore providers. The app is built for Java 26 (pom.xml:29 project.jdk.version=26, compiler release at pom.xml:346) and ships a JDK 26 runtime, so JSSE defaults negotiate TLS 1.3/1.2 with classical ECDHE/DHE named groups

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SSLContext.getInstance("TLS") in the different-truststore SSLContext provider base class (enterprise custom truststore feature); JSSE default settings negotiate TLS 1.3/1.2 with classical ECDHE/DHE key exchange only — no post-quantum groups in a stock JDK. Quantum-vulnerable TLS key exchange for Hub/update traffic. Changeable here (JDK 24+ hybrid groups or Conscrypt).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT/JWS capability declared in pom.xml via java-jwt and nimbus-jose-jwt. No JWS signing call site exists in this repo's source (registration JWTs are produced by the Hub server; vault-config token handling lives in the cryptofs dependency). Dependency-level capability asset: the shipped classpath can sign JWTs (HS256/RS256/ES256/ES384 via nimbus), which matters for CBOM coverage.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JOSE in active use in the Hub keyloading package: JWE with ECDH-ES key agreement + A256GCM content encryption (JWEHelper.encryptUserKey), PBES2 password-based JWE decryption (JWEHelper.decryptUserKey via PasswordBasedDecrypter), P-384 JWKs. All JOSE algorithms in use are quantum-vulnerable (ECDH-ES) or classical (AES-GCM). Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context

Ships ECDH/ECDSA/AES/PBKDF2 implementations in the application classpath. Core dependency inventory asset.
